meta.title: 4ELEMENTS – Automation for online retailers | Make, Shopify, Amazon
meta.description: I automate recurring workflows for online retailers with Make – Shopify, Amazon, spreadsheets, email – and look after running automations. 4ELEMENTS e.K., Berlin.

hero.headline: Automations that keep running.
hero.subline: I automate recurring workflows for online retailers and make sure they keep running reliably.

intro._hinweis: Homepage intro and hero workflow. Exactly 9 modules in fixed roles; the 4 with "hero": true also appear in the hero. Icons: bag, sheet, router, globe, braces, spark, mail, iterator, hash, check, filter, doc, cart, bell, chat, store, user, box, pulse.

problem.label: The problem
problem.text: Transferring orders, creating invoices, checking stock, sorting requests. The same manual steps every day, and each one costs time and invites mistakes. Automations solve this, but only as long as they are maintained.

cards.title: New automations
cards.text: I connect your shop, marketplace, spreadsheets, email and AI services into workflows that run without manual work.

cards.title: Repair and stabilisation
cards.text: Existing Make scenarios that run unreliably – I review them, repair them and protect them against errors.

cards.title: Ongoing support
cards.text: I monitor your automations and fix errors before they cost you revenue.

support.headline: Support for running automations.
support.subline: Cancel monthly. Costs for Make and other tools are covered by you.

plans.name: Premium
plans.report: yes, plus priority handling of new requests

support.note: Larger new developments are offered separately. Access to your Make organisation is required.

steps.title: Conversation
steps.text: You describe your workflow, I check what can be automated.

steps.title: Acceptance criteria
steps.text: We agree up front how we will know that everything works.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.text: Tested, protected against errors and clearly documented.

steps.title: Support
steps.text: If you like, I make sure on an ongoing basis that everything keeps running.

about.headline: About me
about.text: I'm Haydar Hinisli and have been an online retailer myself since 2021, with my own brand on Amazon. I know the workflows I automate from my own experience. My company 4ELEMENTS e.K. is based in Berlin.

contact.headline: Contact
contact.text: Briefly tell me which tools you use and what should be automated. You will receive a reply within one business day.
